parsed.title: Discussion on tax issues, domain purchase, and low‑profit app ideas

claims.text: Paying aunt Sveta 500 UAH helped avoid a huge main‑penalty caused by mis‑labelled columns in the declaration.
The whole correction procedure takes about an hour with Excel, at most one day.
The main difficulty is not the tax calculation itself but checking which column subtracts which number.

topics.title: Low profitability of a web‑only app

claims.text: Web is the simplest platform but much less profitable than Android/iOS; SEO is poor, no external traffic, and conversion is assumed near zero.
Successful projects aim for < 1 week delivery using a fast cross‑platform stack (e.g., Flutter) and copying popular features with minor tweaks.

topics.title: Skepticism about pricing and source‑code security

claims.text: The app is priced at 299 UAH but the source code is hidden; a password is stored locally as a 100 % discount promo code.
Participants suspect the app may be pirated or a scam, with the password easily discoverable.
